The structure of Li12Ti8O24 (reduced formula Li3Ti2O6) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 44 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral environments throughout: Li centers coordinate six O neighbors, Ti centers also six O neighbors, and O centers have four Li and two Ti neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.0006–2.3178 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 44 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between Li octahedra and between Li and Ti octahedra, though these patterns are not exclusive to all polyhedra.
